fields.title: Apply coupon codes at checkout / 结算页支持优惠码
fields.requester: Marketing — Grace Ho / 市场部 何佳
fields.acceptance: A valid code lowers the total before payment; an expired code says why it failed; the code survives a page refresh. / 有效优惠码在付款前扣减总价；过期码说明失败原因；刷新页面后已填的码还在。

fields.title: Repeated taps create duplicate orders / 连点提交会重复下单
fields.acceptance: Tapping Pay five times quickly creates exactly one order. / 快速连点「支付」五次只生成一笔订单。

fields.title: Show a delivery-date estimate on the cart / 购物车显示预计送达日期
fields.acceptance: Each cart line shows an estimated date; items from two warehouses show two dates. / 购物车每行显示预计送达日期；来自两个仓的商品显示两个日期。

fields.title: Saved addresses at checkout / 结算页收货地址簿
fields.acceptance: A returning shopper picks a saved address in one tap and can add or delete one. / 老用户一次点击选中已存地址，并能新增或删除地址。

fields.title: Apple Pay on web checkout / 网页结算支持 Apple Pay
fields.requester: Sales — Ken Lau / 销售 刘健
fields.acceptance: Safari users see Apple Pay as a payment option and complete an order with it. / Safari 用户能看到 Apple Pay 选项并用它完成下单。
fields.details: Two enterprise prospects asked for it in October demos. / 十月有两家企业客户在演示中提出。

fields.title: Checkout loads slowly on 3G / 3G 网络下结算页加载慢
fields.acceptance: Checkout is usable within 3 seconds on a throttled 3G profile. / 在限速 3G 条件下结算页 3 秒内可操作。

fields.title: PDF invoices with tax breakdown / 含税明细的 PDF 发票
fields.requester: Finance — Olivia Xu / 财务 徐欧
fields.acceptance: Every paid order produces a PDF with line items, tax per line, and the company tax ID. / 每笔已付款订单都生成 PDF，含商品明细、逐行税额和公司税号。

fields.title: Invoice numbering per legal entity / 按法人主体编号发票
fields.requester: Finance — Olivia Xu / 财务 徐欧
fields.acceptance: Each legal entity has its own gap-free invoice sequence. / 每个法人主体有各自连续、不跳号的发票序列。

fields.title: Email invoices to the billing contact / 发票邮件发送给账单联系人
fields.requester: Finance — Olivia Xu / 财务 徐欧
fields.acceptance: The billing contact receives the PDF within five minutes of payment. / 付款后五分钟内账单联系人收到 PDF。

fields.title: Retry failed payment webhooks / 支付失败回调自动重试
fields.acceptance: A webhook that fails is retried with backoff up to 24 hours, and the order is not lost. / 失败的回调按退避策略最多重试 24 小时，订单不丢失。

fields.title: Rate-limit the public pricing API / 公共价格接口限流
fields.acceptance: A client above 100 requests a minute gets HTTP 429 with a Retry-After header; normal clients are unaffected. / 每分钟超过 100 次请求的客户端收到带 Retry-After 的 HTTP 429；正常客户端不受影响。
fields.details: Blocked on the gateway config change owned by the platform team. / 卡在平台组负责的网关配置变更上。

fields.title: Month-end reconciliation totals do not match / 月末对账报表金额不一致
fields.requester: Finance — Olivia Xu / 财务 徐欧
fields.details: September totals differ from the bank statement by 0.3%. / 九月合计与银行流水相差 0.3%。

fields.title: Export orders to CSV / 订单导出 CSV
fields.acceptance: Store staff export a filtered order list and open it in Excel with names intact. / 门店人员导出筛选后的订单列表，用 Excel 打开时姓名显示正常。

fields.title: Exported CSV shows garbled Chinese in Excel / 导出的 CSV 在 Excel 里中文乱码
fields.acceptance: A CSV with Chinese names opens correctly in Excel on Windows and macOS. / 含中文姓名的 CSV 在 Windows 和 macOS 的 Excel 中都显示正常。
fields.details: Found during acceptance of the CSV export delivery. / 在「订单导出 CSV」交付验收时发现。

fields.title: Order timestamps show the wrong time zone / 订单时间显示的时区错误
fields.acceptance: Order times show in the store's local time zone. / 订单时间按门店所在时区显示。

fields.title: Refund request queue for support agents / 客服退款申请队列
fields.acceptance: Support sees every open refund request with its order and can approve or reject it. / 客服能看到每条待处理退款申请及其订单，并能通过或驳回。

fields.title: Role permissions for store managers / 门店店长角色权限
Dark mode for the admin console / 运营后台深色模式
Bulk-edit product tags / 批量编辑商品标签
fields.details: Replaced by the catalogue import tool planned for Q1. / 由 Q1 规划的商品导入工具替代。
